defs.def: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about sth without being sure of all the facts 猜测；估计

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装一个袋子、切一块蛋糕、猜猜哪个果汁容器装的水最多，还有很多其他活动。
他们喜欢猜来电者的身份。

ex.s: Try to work out what type of word it is (noun, adjective, verb, etc), then use the words before and after it to help you guess the meaning.
ex.t: 尝试确定它是什么类型的词(名词,形容词,动词等),然后使用它前后的词来帮助你猜测意义.

ex.s: It is impossible to know the meaning of every word, but knowing about word formation can help us guess their meanings.
ex.t: 不可能知道每个单词的意思，但了解构词法可以帮助我们猜测词义。

defs.def: to find the right answer to a question or the truth without knowing all the facts 猜对；猜中；猜到
to suppose that sth is true or likely 想；以为

ex.s: “I guess this is it,” he said.
（1分）﹣I guess you want to go play tennis．
That way, you’ll make the most your time at senior high.” People say, “Well begun, half done.” I guess this was a good beginning to my new school life.
ex.t: 那样的话，你就会充分利用你的高中时光。"人们说："好的开始是成功的一半。"我想这是我对新学校生活的一个良好开端。

ex.s: I guess love is indeed a magical ingredient.
ex.t: 我想爱确实是一种神奇的成分。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: That said, to be honest the only people who ever ring our home phone are our Baby Boomers parents, to the point where we play a game and guess who is calling before we pick up the phone （using Caller ID would take the fun out of it）.
ex.t: 也就是说，老实说，唯一会给我们家座机打电话的人是我们婴儿潮一代的父母，以至于我们会玩个游戏，在接电话前猜是谁打来的（用来电显示会破坏这种乐趣）。

defs.def: （引出令人惊奇或激动的事）你猜

ex.s: I guess that there's probably some demanding work schedule, or social anxiety around stepping up to help for an unknown sport.
ex.t: 我猜大概是有些苛刻的工作安排，或是对于为一个不熟悉的运动挺身相助的社会焦虑。

ex.s: And guess what almost half of the surveyed kids said they do before bedtime?
ex.t: 而且，你猜近一半受访的孩子说他们睡前会做什么？
